name: Fujishima Saki
source:
Ayame's daughter and Student Council President.
A strong-willed young lady, accomplished in both studies and sports. Prideful and a sore loser, yet with an air of cuteness about her.
Saki greatly admires her mother and works hard to earn her approval.
